title: Goat Feed Station Queue Time
dataSources: Hive metrics (`flowhive:reading`), egg counter events (`eggcounter:event`), goat RFID visits (`goattag:scan`), goat watering and feed logs (`goatcare:event`), and compost readings (`compost:reading`).
app: Smallholding and backyard telemetry from Flow Hive scales, chicken coop counters, RFID goat tags, compost thermometers, and camera-driven chore logs sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goatcare:event
| search event_type="feed_queue" queue_sec=*
| stats avg(queue_sec) as avg_queue_sec perc90(queue_sec) as p90_queue_sec count as samples by station_id
| sort 0 - avg_queue_sec
description: Measures goat feed-station waiting time by feed station.
value: Queue time shows whether one station is becoming a bottleneck or bullying hotspot.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for goat feed-station waiting time to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 goat feed-station waiting time.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how long goat feed-station waiting time usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
